provider_mechanics.bounded_prefetch: for each non-concurrent signal, fetch up to the frozen 1440-complete-bar horizon before local event evaluation; prefetch may read bars after an earlier stop/target but cannot alter any frozen parameter or admit data beyond the strict OOS end

dedup.same_activation_known_at: keep latest swing_confirmed_at_utc; tie lexicographically greatest trigger_id

portfolio.open_interval_equality: a signal with knowledge_time <= prior exit M1 start is skipped concurrent; this conservatively treats the exit minute as occupied
portfolio.invalid_risk: entry_price <= rejection_low => INVALID_RISK_ORDERING, excluded from resolved metrics and not a provider integrity failure
portfolio.right_censored: insufficient bars before strict OOS end => RIGHT_CENSORED_OOS_END, excluded from resolved metrics

metric_definitions.profit_factor: sum positive net_r / abs(sum negative net_r); if no negative net_r and positive sum, treat as +infinity for threshold comparisons and serialize null with no_negative_trades=true
metric_definitions.max_drawdown_r: maximum peak-to-trough decline of cumulative chronological net_r
metric_definitions.bootstrap: IID resample executed resolved net_r, 10000 replicates, seed 20260817, 2.5/97.5 percentiles

scenario_independence: base and stress process concurrency independently against the same immutable provider cache
